lessons.text: For /dg full integrations, SKILL.md and comic-template.html form one deployable unit because Step 4 resolves the template relative to the installed skill directory; acceptance must execute the installer with isolated HOME and assert byte equality.
The Codex guide edit is content-trivial but .codex is a separately read-only workspace path in this harness; apply_patch cannot write .codex/INSTALL.md despite normal Unix mode bits.

Round 5 still lacks effective write access to .codex/INSTALL.md: root is writable generally, but the more-specific .codex read-only permission causes apply_patch to reject the file as outside the project.

Round 7 still does not provide effective write access to .codex/INSTALL.md: apply_patch is rejected as outside the project because the more-specific .codex sandbox entry remains read-only, despite the workspace root being writable.
